September 5, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:44+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-5-1971-54678

A group of freedom fighters led by MA Jinnah is advancing towards the Chittagong metropolitan. On the way they confronted a joint force of Razakar Bahini and Pak troops. The enemies experienced numerous casualties. The specialty of this Mukti Bahini group is: Only the leader is an adult; rest of crew is under 15 years.

An announcement from the Pakistani government read: Those members of armed force, government officials, MNA, MPA who are sued by the martial court before September 4, they will not get general mercy.
